name: global-memory
description: Adds a machine-wide memory folder beside the per-project auto memory, so facts about the machine reach every session from any folder: rewrites the memory section for both folders and loads the global MEMORY.md.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Add the machine-wide memory folder to every session. Off, the memory section stays as Claude Code wrote it.

globalDir.title: Global memory folder
globalDir.description: Folder of the machine-wide memory, with its own MEMORY.md. It can be a folder in a git repo, to version the memories. A leading ~ is your home folder.

wikiDir.title: ai-memory wiki folder
wikiDir.description: Wiki folder of an ai-memory server (github.com/akitaonrails/ai-memory), such as ~/.local/share/ai-memory/wiki. Set, the global index comes from the _rules/indice-memorias.md page of the wiki's _global project, and the project index from the same page of the project named like the folder the project memory links to. A missing page falls back to MEMORY.md.
